policy.source_rule: Official paper/project/author code only; unknown fields are not inferred.
policy.interpretation: API access, open weights, parameter training, and external software/tools are reported separately.

summary.primary_recommendation: Open-weight primary results, second open architecture for transfer, commercial API only as optional ceiling/judge.

papers.title: CLOVA: A Closed-Loop Visual Assistant with Tool Usage and Update
papers.actor: GPT-3.5 in the main tool-use comparison; the paper also evaluates Llama2-7B and GPT-4.
papers.critic_or_judge: The same LLM loop provides reflection; task-specific visual tools provide executable feedback.
papers.api_role: GPT-3.5-turbo and GPT-4 are commercial API models; text-davinci-002 is used by the LIST tool. Llama2-7B is the open-weight alternative.
papers.parameter_updates: No full LLM fine-tuning. Correct/incorrect demonstrations are stored for in-context updates; visual-tool backbones stay frozen while soft prompts are tuned.
papers.data: GQA, NLVRv2, plus manually collected image-editing and factual-knowledge tasks.
papers.hardware: Unknown in the official main paper text inspected.
papers.code: Official project page and code are public.

implication.zh: 商业 API 不是闭环更新的唯一实现；低资源复现可使用本地开源规划器与冻结视觉工具，但必须单独报告 API 与开源规划器的差异。
implication.en: Commercial APIs are not the only implementation of closed-loop updating. A low-resource reproduction can use an open local planner and frozen visual tools, but API and open-planner results must be separated.

papers.title: Self-Training Large Language Models for Improved Visual Program Synthesis with Visual Reinforcement
papers.actor: An open code LLM is self-trained for visual program synthesis; the exact checkpoint variant must be taken from the released configuration before reproduction.
papers.critic_or_judge: Sparse binary execution reward and filtered behavioral cloning; fewer than 50 manually written corrections extend training.
papers.api_role: The core method is designed to avoid dependence on strong commercial program generators such as GPT-4.
papers.parameter_updates: The code model is updated through reinforced self-training / filtered behavioral cloning.
papers.data: Object detection, compositional VQA, and image-text retrieval tasks.
papers.hardware: Unknown until the official PDF/configuration is checked for the exact run.

implication.zh: 若论文贡献依赖模型参数自进化，可以用 7B 级开源代码/VLM 做 LoRA 或小规模自训练；但当前低资源 Idea 更适合冻结主干，只更新小模块。
implication.en: When the contribution truly requires parameter self-evolution, a 7B open model can be adapted with LoRA or small-scale self-training. Most current low-resource ideas should still freeze the backbone and update only small components.

papers.title: Self-Evolving Visual Concept Library using Vision-Language Critics
papers.actor: A visual concept library and downstream visual reasoning system; exact foundation-model checkpoints must be read from the official configuration.
papers.critic_or_judge: Vision-language critics evaluate and refine concepts.
papers.api_role: The official abstract establishes VLM critics but does not by itself prove whether every reported critic is API-hosted or local.
papers.parameter_updates: The evolving object is the concept library rather than unrestricted full-backbone training.
papers.data: Visual concept learning and downstream recognition/reasoning benchmarks reported in the paper.
papers.hardware: Unknown from the official abstract/project metadata inspected.
papers.code: Use the official author repository when reproducing; exact availability is recorded as pending if the repository is not linked from the paper page.

implication.zh: 把可进化对象限制为概念库、记忆或工具，比全量训练 VLM 更符合低资源设置；但 Critic 必须有本地可复现版本。
implication.en: Restricting evolution to a concept library, memory, or tools is more compatible with low-resource work than full VLM training, but a locally reproducible critic is required.

papers.title: VISCO: Benchmarking Fine-Grained Critique and Correction towards Self-Improvement in Visual Reasoning
papers.actor: The released evaluation supports proprietary GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-1.5-Pro and many local open LVLMs including Qwen2-VL, Molmo, InternVL2, LLaVA, NVLM, and Llama-3.2-Vision families.
papers.critic_or_judge: LookBack is an inference-time prompting strategy; the released explanation-F1 evaluator uses an OpenAI API model unless replaced.
papers.api_role: Commercial APIs are one evaluated model group and are used by the provided assisted evaluator, but open models can be run locally through vLLM/lmdeploy/sglang.
papers.parameter_updates: Benchmarking and LookBack do not require backbone training.
papers.data: 1,645 question-answer pairs with 5,604 fine-grained step annotations.
papers.hardware: Local serving requirements depend on the selected LVLM; no single universal hardware setting applies.

implication.zh: 主实验可以完全基于本地开源 Actor/Critic；商业 API 只作为上界或辅助评测，并必须同时报告调用次数、模型版本和替代的本地评测。
implication.en: The main experiment can use local open actors and critics. Commercial APIs should be optional ceilings or assisted evaluators, with call counts, fixed versions, and a local alternative reported.

papers.title: Critic-V: VLM Critics Help Catch VLM Errors in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.actor: A reasoner VLM is paired with an independent critic; exact released reasoner/critic checkpoints should be taken from the official code/configuration.
papers.critic_or_judge: The critic is trained with DPO on preference critiques ranked by a rule-based reward.
papers.api_role: GPT-4V is an evaluated comparison; the method contribution is an independently trained critic rather than an API-only prompt loop.
papers.parameter_updates: Critic parameters are trained with DPO; this is not inference-only.
papers.data: Multimodal reasoning and critique data described in the paper.
papers.hardware: Unknown until the official appendix/configuration is checked.
papers.code: Official paper/project materials should be used; exact repository availability is marked pending here.

implication.zh: 独立 Critic 能减少共享盲点，但训练 Critic 会增加成本。低资源方案应先比较冻结的异构开源 Critic，再决定是否需要小型 DPO/LoRA。
implication.en: An independent critic can reduce shared blind spots, but critic training adds cost. A low-resource study should first compare a frozen heterogeneous open critic before adding small DPO/LoRA training.

papers.title: Can Large Vision-Language Models Correct Semantic Grounding Errors By Themselves?
papers.actor: The official study evaluates GPT-4V/GPT-4o and additional LVLMs; the correction procedure is prompt-based and model-agnostic.
papers.critic_or_judge: The model performs iterative binary verification and correction.
papers.api_role: GPT models require commercial APIs, but the method itself does not structurally require API access.
papers.parameter_updates: No fine-tuning, architecture change, or external training data.
papers.data: Semantic grounding evaluation sets reported in the paper.
papers.hardware: Not applicable to hosted GPT runs; local-model hardware depends on the selected open checkpoint.

implication.zh: 推理时自纠正非常省训练资源，但必须控制迭代调用预算，并证明收益来自视觉复核而非更多 token 或更多采样。
implication.en: Inference-time self-correction is training-efficient, but iteration budgets must be controlled and gains must be separated from simply using more tokens or samples.

papers.title: Phoenix: A Motion-based Self-Reflection Framework for Fine-grained Robotic Action Correction
papers.actor: A motion-conditioned diffusion policy is paired with an MLLM-driven motion-adjustment component; exact MLLM checkpoint should be verified from the official configuration.
papers.api_role: Unknown for the exact MLLM until the official config is checked; the policy itself is trained and locally executable.
papers.parameter_updates: The diffusion policy/lifelong component is trained; this is not a training-free method.
papers.data: RoboMimic simulation and real-world robotic experiments.
papers.hardware: Exact training hardware remains pending official appendix/configuration verification.
papers.code: Official author GitHub repository is public.

implication.zh: 完整复现成本较高。我们的具身方向应先在公开轨迹与仿真重放上冻结 OpenVLA，只训练审计器或记忆门控。
implication.en: Full reproduction is costly. Our embodied work should first freeze OpenVLA and train only an auditor or memory gate on public trajectories and simulator replay.

papers.title: Visual Agentic AI for Spatial Reasoning with a Dynamic API
papers.actor: Collaborating LLM agents generate and use a dynamic Python visual API; exact LLM versions should be read from the official paper/configuration.
papers.critic_or_judge: Execution results and specialist agents provide feedback for API creation and use.
papers.api_role: The official abstract establishes LLM-based program synthesis but does not alone identify whether every main run is hosted API or local open weights.
papers.parameter_updates: The evolving artifact is the dynamic API/program library; full foundation-model training is not the central mechanism.

implication.zh: 工具/API 进化可以冻结基础模型完成，但必须把程序生成器的 API 依赖作为变量，并提供本地开源规划器对照。
implication.en: Tool/API evolution can freeze the foundation model, but the program generator's API dependency must be treated as an experimental variable with a local open-planner control.

papers.title: VisPlay: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models
papers.actor: Qwen2.5-VL and MiMo-VL model families are used as trainable questioner/reasoner substrates.
papers.critic_or_judge: Self-play difficulty/diversity rewards and verifiable task signals guide GRPO.
papers.api_role: Commercial model APIs are not required for the core training loop.
papers.parameter_updates: Questioner and reasoner are jointly optimized with GRPO on large unlabeled-image collections.
papers.data: Large-scale unlabeled images plus multimodal reasoning evaluations.
papers.hardware: High-resource distributed training; exact configuration should be copied from the official appendix before reproduction.

implication.zh: 它证明全参数/强化学习式视觉自进化可以用开源权重完成，但不适合作为当前低资源复现目标；应作为高资源上界。
implication.en: It demonstrates open-weight RL-style visual self-evolution, but is unsuitable as the current low-resource reproduction target and should be treated as a high-resource ceiling.

papers.title: JarvisEvo: Towards a Self-Evolving Photo Editing Agent with Synergistic Editor-Evaluator Optimization
papers.actor: The released JarvisEvo-8B editor/evaluator stack integrates Qwen-Image-Edit and an Adobe Lightroom tool space.
papers.critic_or_judge: A dual editor-evaluator loop is optimized with SFT/SEPO/RFT-style stages reported by the project.
papers.api_role: A commercial LLM API is not required for the released 8B model, but Adobe Lightroom is a proprietary software dependency.
papers.parameter_updates: The editor/evaluator system is trained; this is not inference-only.
papers.data: ArtEdit-Bench and editing data released/described by the project.
papers.hardware: Exact training hardware should be taken from the official appendix; inference weights are roughly 17 GB according to the release.
papers.code: Official GitHub repository and model weights are public under their stated license.

implication.zh: 开源 8B 编辑 Agent 可本地验证，但闭源工具依赖仍需显式报告。低资源研究可用 SDXL/FLUX 与开源编辑工具替代。
implication.en: The open 8B editing agent can be evaluated locally, but proprietary tool dependencies must be disclosed. Low-resource work can substitute SDXL/FLUX and open editing tools.

papers.title: OctoT2I: A Self-Evolving Agentic Text-to-Image Router
papers.actor: An agentic router selects among multiple text-to-image tools and maintains an evolving capability knowledge base.
papers.critic_or_judge: The propose-solve-evaluate-learn loop evaluates tool capability and routing outcomes.
papers.api_role: Exact API/open-weight composition of every tool is pending verification from the official full paper and release.
papers.parameter_updates: The capability knowledge base/router evolves; unrestricted full generator training is not the central contribution.
papers.data: Text-to-image prompts and quality/efficiency evaluations described in the paper.
papers.code: The official paper indicates release status; use the author release when available.

implication.zh: 路由和能力记忆可做低资源研究，但必须分别报告本地生成器与外部 API 工具的调用成本和可复现性。
implication.en: Routing and capability memory are low-resource research targets, but local generators and external API tools must have separate cost and reproducibility reporting.

papers.title: EvoGraph-R1: Self-Evolving Multimodal Knowledge Hypergraphs for Agentic Retrieval
papers.actor: A multimodal agent selects GraphRetrieve, WebSearch, GraphEdit, and Answer actions over a dynamic hypergraph.
papers.critic_or_judge: Retrieval and graph-edit outcomes provide the evolution signal.
papers.api_role: Web search is an external service/tool; exact foundation-model and API choices remain pending official supplementary verification.
papers.parameter_updates: The main evolving state is the multimodal graph rather than necessarily the foundation-model weights.
papers.data: Agentic multimodal retrieval benchmarks reported in the paper.
papers.code: Use the official CVF/project release when available.

implication.zh: 图或记忆状态进化比模型权重训练更省资源，但外部搜索服务、缓存与图版本必须进入实验成本和复现协议。
implication.en: Graph or memory-state evolution is cheaper than weight training, but external search services, caching, and graph versions must be included in cost and reproducibility protocols.
